sideEffects.via: α2B (thalamus), α2C and imidazoline receptor actions

pearls: Best candidate for **α2 monotherapy** in ADHD: hypothetically low PFC norepinephrine with no added dopamine problem.
No postsynaptic **DA receptor** action, which parallels the lack of abuse potential.
For **opioid withdrawal**, adding naltrexone to clonidine or lofexidine also shortens the course, not just its severity.
In pain, works by mimicking **descending noradrenergic** input onto inhibitory α2 receptors on primary afferent terminals.
Reversal of opioid effects works only if given **early enough** and in sufficient dose, since it competes at the receptor.
Not absorbed by mouth or under the tongue, so it is **active by injection**; this is why the combination tablet deters injection.
Listed with sedating **mirtazapine and TCAs**; the book frames these second-line drugs as helping sleep disturbance in fibromyalgia.

sideEffects.e: **Low abuse liability** and milder side effects than amphetamine or methylphenidate
sideEffects.via: Slow, incomplete DAT occupancy raising tonic rather than phasic dopamine

pearls: Approved for **OSA and shift work disorder**, which amphetamine and methylphenidate are not.
In OSA, an **adjunct** to CPAP-type airway treatment; sometimes used off-label alone when CPAP is not tolerated (adherence only about 54%).
In shift work disorder, pair with **circadian measures** such as timed bright light.
In the **arousal combo**, the SNRI boosts 5HT and NE while modafinil adds a single dopamine boost; with a stimulant, NE is boosted twice.
For **fibro-fog**, sits with atomoxetine, bupropion and cautious stimulants; SNRI plus modafinil can also address physical fatigue.
Its pharmacokinetics could give more **phasic dopamine** firing than racemic modafinil.
No head-to-head trials against stimulants exist, so **relative potency** in narcolepsy is unproven.
For fibromyalgia, SNRI plus armodafinil can address **physical and mental fatigue**.
Sleep-hygiene advice for insomnia: **avoid caffeine** near bedtime, along with alcohol and nicotine.
Its wake effect comes from **reducing homeostatic sleep drive**, since adenosine builds up as fatigue accumulates.
A **controlled substance** supplied through a central pharmacy in the US.
Naturally occurring in the brain, **made from GABA**, with its own receptors.
Unlike other sleepiness drugs, it does not raise wake-promoting transmitters; it works through **night-time sleep**.
In fibromyalgia, reserved for refractory cases because of **slow-wave sleep** benefit versus diversion risk.

sideEffects.e: “Date rape” misuse with alcohol (sedation, amnesia); abuse by athletes for growth hormone surge

pearls: Book context: **CSF orexin** below about 110 pg/mL is diagnostic, but levels are often normal without cataplexy.
